# qbittorrent_watch_folders (Resource)

Singleton authoritative ownership of qBittorrent's complete watched-folder map. Import ID: application. `folders` replaces the whole server map; an explicit empty map clears it, while omitting or removing `folders` relinquishes ownership without changing watches. Destroy preserves server watches. Import reads and adopts the complete current map. Paths refer to the qBittorrent server. qBittorrent may silently ignore invalid paths, so configured maps are verified against the normalized server response. This only configures watches; acceptance uses empty directories and does not add torrents or remove files.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "qbittorrent_watch_folders" "application" {
  folders = {
    "/downloads/watch-default" = {
      save_mode = "default"
    }
    "/downloads/watch-here" = {
      save_mode = "watch_folder"
    }
    "/downloads/watch-custom" = {
      save_mode = "custom"
      save_path = "/downloads/complete"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `folders` (Attributes Map) Complete watched-folder map keyed by server paths. Modes are `default`, `watch_folder`, or `custom`; `save_path` is required only for `custom`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton ID: application.

<a id="nestedatt--folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders`

Required:

- `save_mode` (String) Use the default save path, save into the watched folder, or use a custom save path.

Optional:

- `save_path` (String) Custom save path on the qBittorrent server; required when `save_mode = "custom"`.
